turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that?
An answer to what, Hale? I'm the one waiting on one. Was Owen heard before that mark went in?
Either Owen admits it in writing by Friday at 3 PM or the zero goes on his transcript.

I'm writing that down, word for word: "Either Owen admits it in writing by Friday at 3 PM or the zero goes on his transcript." Admits what, on what evidence, under which section of your own procedure? Nothing goes on his record, and if that's your position, I'm in the principal's office when we're done here.
Those are the only two options. Pick one.
Neither. Your own procedure, 4.2, says you call me before any mark goes in, and 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish anything. Show me what you actually have, Hale, or I'm going upstairs.
